ll_tv.label: Love Live! Sunshine!! - TV anime look (best)
ll_tv.about: The lab's best recipe: the show's character designer (@murota yuuhei), the year it aired and 'anime screenshot'. Your own characters stay yours.
ll_tv.template: masterpiece, best quality, year 2016, anime screenshot, {character}, @murota yuuhei, {body}, {scene}

ll_card.label: Love Live! - soft card / official art look
ll_card.about: Same designer, but 'official art' instead of 'anime screenshot': softer light and colour, like the game cards.
ll_card.template: masterpiece, best quality, year 2016, official art, {character}, @murota yuuhei, {body}, {scene}

ll_2020.label: Love Live! - newer, crisper look (year 2020)
ll_2020.about: The designer with a later year: a little sharper and cleaner, same faces.
ll_2020.template: masterpiece, best quality, year 2020, anime screenshot, {character}, @murota yuuhei, {body}, {scene}

ll_canon.label: Love Live! Sunshine!! - canon (series tag)
ll_canon.about: Adds the show's name. Strongest Love Live look, but it pulls in the show's uniforms, hair and even its characters (a silver-haired girl turns into You). Use it for fan art of the real characters.
ll_canon.template: masterpiece, best quality, year 2016, anime screenshot, love live! sunshine!!, {character}, @murota yuuhei, {body}, {scene}

ll_soft.label: Love Live x kantoku - softer, more detail (experimental)
ll_soft.about: A second artist tag (@kantoku) blended with the Love Live designer: softer shading and finer detail, faces still Love Live-ish. Tested on 2 seeds by Claude, not judged by a person yet.
ll_soft.template: masterpiece, best quality, year 2016, anime screenshot, {character}, @murota yuuhei, @kantoku, {body}, {scene}

ll_watercolor.label: Love Live x fuzichoco - pale watercolour feel (experimental)
ll_watercolor.about: Blend with @fuzichoco: paler, airy colours with a painted feel. Tested on 2 seeds by Claude, not judged by a person yet.
ll_watercolor.template: masterpiece, best quality, year 2016, anime screenshot, {character}, @murota yuuhei, @fuzichoco, {body}, {scene}

ll_90s.label: Love Live, 90s anime (experimental)
ll_90s.about: The designer tag turned down to 0.6, year 1995 and retro tags: a 1990s TV anime look with sharper faces and darker shading. Tested on 2 seeds by Claude, not judged by a person yet.
ll_90s.template: masterpiece, best quality, year 1995, (retro artstyle:1.4), (1990s (style):1.5), {character}, (@murota yuuhei:0.6), {body}, {scene}
